title: Implement Banking-Grade Security Controls
problem_statement: Platform lacks encryption, audit trails, and access controls required for banking compliance
risk_if_unaddressed: Regulatory violations, data breaches, failed compliance audits
suggested_approach: Implement OAuth2/JWT authentication, encrypt data at rest, add comprehensive audit logging, establish role-based access controls
success_criteria: Complete audit trail for all operations

provenance.evidence: No encryption or access controls detected

title: Design Transactional Data Migration Strategy
problem_statement: No evidence of ACID-compliant migration from Access to PostgreSQL with rollback capabilities
risk_if_unaddressed: Data corruption, transaction loss, inability to rollback failed migrations
suggested_approach: Implement dual-write pattern, create migration validation framework, establish rollback procedures, add data integrity checks

provenance.evidence: Database engineer exists but no migration strategy evident

title: Replace File-Based Storage with Enterprise Database
problem_statement: JSON file storage lacks ACID properties, concurrent access controls, and scalability for banking operations
risk_if_unaddressed: Data corruption under load, configuration drift, inability to handle banking transaction volumes
suggested_approach: Migrate to PostgreSQL-based configuration store, implement connection pooling, add transaction support, create backup/recovery procedures

provenance.evidence: File-based storage insufficient for production banking

title: Implement Banking-Grade Test Coverage
problem_statement: No evidence of unit tests, integration tests, or compliance validation tests for banking domain
risk_if_unaddressed: Production failures, regulatory violations, inability to validate VB6 behavior parity
suggested_approach: Implement pytest-based testing, create VB6 behavior validation tests, add load testing, establish CI/CD pipeline with compliance gates
success_criteria: Load testing for banking transaction volumes

provenance.evidence: Tester agent exists but no test implementation visible
